pages.text: At dusk the server may pick a lunar event for the night. Each moon has its own chance and look; only one can be up at a time, and it sets at dawn.$(br2)A moon only affects the dimension it rises in (normally the Overworld). The Nether and the End never get one.
pages.title: How Moons Work

pages.text: You'll see a message when a moon rises and when it sets. The sky, fog and light change colour while it's up, and some moons add particles or sounds.$(br2)Players who join in the middle of a moon see it straight away.$(br2)How much of the sky effects you see is set per player in $(o)config/ecmoons-client.toml$(): $(l)quality$() OFF / LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH. It never changes what a moon does.
